focus_areas: Leg joint connectivity in the central cluster
Texture fidelity of the crushed ice
Accuracy of dorsal carapace mottling patterns
Connectivity of limbs to body segments in occluded areas
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the junction points where legs meet the body. In AI images of crab piles, legs often 'melt' into the torso or other legs. Verify if the serrated edges of the claws look like distinct geometric teeth or just noisy texture. Check if the ice has realistic refraction or looks like white noise. Specifically validate that the dorsal shells are indeed visible and not hallucinated textures.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs resting on crushed ice. The crabs are oriented in various directions; while some ventral surfaces are visible, multiple dorsal carapaces are clearly exposed, displaying the characteristic reddish-brown to orange coloration and mottled patterns. Legs and claws are intermingled in a dense arrangement.
